name: legacy-relight
description: Relight of a compiled legacy map (tools/quality/legacy_bsp_relight.py): the gi-fixture light paths (64 diffuse bounces, no clamping) baked on the GPU into a denoised 4096 atlas with separated direct and indirect LMAP v2 layers, a PRBV probe volume at 2 m (a whole Portal map spans about 100 x 60 x 40 m), a radiosity transfer at 1 m patches and an SDFV at 0.4 m voxels for the SDF-traced producer. The map's nodraw brush sides (relight_occluder) occlude in every bake but get no atlas space and are left out of the world mesh. No reflection probe, directional page or pipeline reference render.
